newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Crew saved from Spanish vessel off Morocco.
newsitem.headline: Crew saved from Spanish vessel off Morocco.

text.p: A Moroccan trawler has rescued all the crew of a Spanish ship which sank off the west coast of Morocco just before midnight, a port official said on Tuesday.
The Montero Hermanos, believed to be a trawler, sent out a distress call on Monday, reporting it was "taking water and going down", Lloyd's of London said.
"It has sunk. All the crew were rescued and are safe," an official at the harbour master's office in Morocco's southern Agadir port told Reuters by telephone.
"They were rescued by the Moroccan trawler Caboghir at 2355 GMT last night," he said.
He had no other details or crew numbers but said they were being brought to Morocco.
